newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Wheelock's parent seen in shr placement.
newsitem.headline: Wheelock's parent seen in shr placement.

text.p: Wheelock and Co Ltd's major shareholder Barclays Private Bank & Trust Ltd is hoping to place 50 million existing shares in the company to private investors at about HK$22.80 per share, market sources said on Tuesday.
Barclays Private Bank held 59.14 percent of Wheelock as of October 1996.

"The parent of Wheelock is placing 50 million shares at HK$22.80 to HK$22.90 in the market," said one broker, adding that the placement shares represented about 2.5 percent of Wheelock's existing share capital.
Some brokers said market response had not been encouraging and the placement was still ongoing.
They said the placement price represented a five percent discount to Tuesday's closing price of HK$24.00.
